يقتضون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَضُونَ (yaqtaḍūna) /jaq.ta.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# يُقْتَضَوْنَ (yuqtaḍawna) /juq.ta.dˤaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
